in_marathi.name: Krishnandan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Krishnandan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Krishnandan is a combination of two Sanskrit words, Krishna and Dan. Krishna means 'God' or 'Black' and Dan means 'wealth' or 'grace'. The name signifies the grace and blessings of Lord Krishna.

Krishna means 'God' or 'Black' and Dan means 'wealth' or 'grace'. The name signifies the grace and blessings of Lord Krishna.
